title: Monthly Transaction Allowance and Overage Rate (Corporate Travel Programmes)
content:
Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes carries a quantity of booking transactions included in the subscription each month, and a rate for each booking transaction beyond that allowance. This schedule publishes both figures for every tier.

| Programme tier | Booking transactions included each month | Rate for each transaction beyond the allowance (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 10 | 4.50 |
| Business Team Programme | 50 | 4.00 |
| Business Pro Programme | 250 | 3.25 |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 1200 | 2.50 |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 5000 | 1.75 |
| Business Global Programme | 20000 | 1.00 |

The two figures move in opposite directions across the tiers: the included quantity rises from 10 transactions a month on the Business Starter Programme to 20000 on the Business Global Programme, while the rate for a transaction beyond the allowance falls from 4.50 to 1.00 over the same span. The allowance figure belongs to a month; the rate figure belongs to a single transaction.
